sources.note: SISTER VARIETY ONLY (Djifanghor Nyun, gube1234), not nort3247. Sec. 13.3.1.3 'Stress' (book p. ~294; ocr_quint/): 'JFG is a stress language. Each content word or polysyllabic function word has a stressed syllable... The stress generally falls on the lexical root of nouns and verbs... When the root is longer than one syllable, the stress preferably falls: (i) on the first syllable of the root... (ii) otherwise on the heaviest syllable (e.g. consonantal coda)... The stress seems to only have a demarcative function and no lexical minimal pairs based on stress have been found.' Also 13.3.1.1.2: '…
